PennyPlanner Budget

PennyPlanner Budget 1.3.8. Prototype. Your data stays in this browser. Content 1.3.8, 2026-10-31.

Source

Help

Start

  1. Accounts: add one.
  2. Transactions: type in Quick entry, or import a CSV file.
  3. Expense: use a minus, like -25.50.

Back up

Settings, Backup and tools, Data, Export backup. Keep the file safe. Import backup loads it and replaces everything.

Your data

Stays in this browser, on this device. No account, no cloud. Clearing site data or switching browser shows an empty app. Only the AI buttons send anything (descriptions and category names to Google, with your own key). The key is not encrypted and is never exported.

Erase

Settings, Backup and tools, Data, Erase all data. Cannot be undone. Export first.

Update

Replace the file. Keep the same name and address so your data stays. Export first.

Words

TFSA, RRSP, FHSA
Canadian registered accounts.
Non Reg
Taxable investment account.
CSV
A spreadsheet saved as text.
Apply Rules
Fills empty categories from your Rules.
Tag
A label that links spending to a budget.
